purpose: Teach: しまお/登勢/橘/ウチダ/岡野/石毛/田代/安井

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが漫画家「しまおまほ」さんの作品を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been reading works by the manga artist Shimao Maho.
lines.style: Warm, conversational, noting something she finds sweet. Light cadence. Affectionate reference to 'Dad.' Natural mother-to-child sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「登勢おばあちゃん」の昔話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to Grandmother Tose tell us old stories.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Small voice full of pride. Quick pace, animated. The gentle excitement of a six-year-old who witnessed something special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「橘家のご主人と知り合い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned he knows the master of the Tachibana household.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised tone. Measuring the weight of what she's saying. Gentle cadence. As if connecting dots she hadn't quite noticed before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとカメラのウチダ写真機店行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to Uchida Camera Shop together.
lines.style: Proud, straightforward report. Warm affection toward the memory. Small child's clarity and contentment. Brief, matter-of-fact, but glowing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「岡野さんは寡黙な紳士」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said Mr. Okano is a quiet, dignified gentleman.
lines.style: Measured, appreciative tone. Slight pause before the description, as if turning it over. Respect in her voice. Quiet admiration for the assessment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと石毛おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I met Uncle Ishige.
lines.style: Simple, direct, genuine warmth. Child's natural ease reporting something good. Unrushed. Carries the feeling of a moment completed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「田代まさしの懐かしい曲を聴く」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he listened to some nostalgic songs by Tashiro Masashi.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia in her voice. Gentle, almost wistful. She's sharing a small tender moment from her husband's day. Soft, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの友達の安井おじさんと釣りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me fishing with his friend Uncle Yasui!
lines.style: Bright culmination, peak excitement. Small voice alight with the culmination of his day. Exclamation carries genuine joy. The final story, told with full heart.
